title: A flow step that calls a named agent, under a condition, and keeps its answer in the run record
body: Case: a project (ticket ADO-1309) needs a required review by a project agent named database-engineer, only on tickets that change the database, once before a person approves the plan and once before the pull request. In 0.13.0 a flow step has only id, type, title, instructions and its type's own field, so a step cannot name an agent or run under a condition. The review step always runs its own fixed reviewer. Workaround in the project: rules in the rules folder tell the agent to call the reviewer, and a check command proves it from sessions.jsonl (agentType) and events.jsonl. Limits of that workaround: it reads warden's internal files; the answer of the end review cannot go in the run record, because outputs are not copied there and agents cannot write there; question.answered carries no text, so a person's reason cannot be proven; warden:ticket agents have no Agent tool, so orchestrated runs cannot do the review. Ask: a step option such as a review step with a named agent and a condition on paths in the plan or diff, whose answer and verdict are saved in the run record, and that a person can skip with a written reason.
